analysis: The PR changes documentation only. In docs/architecture/hardware-support.md the "Last updated" date moves to 2026-10-24 (line 3) and the source path for GatedDelta.swift is corrected to libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDelta.swift (line 702). The same date and path correction is made in docs/architecture/inference.md (patch hunks at lines 3 and 609). Unit 9bceb6d953b336e2:0 is a metadata-only entry with no patch text, and I found nothing security-relevant in it. No code, configuration, wire protocol, key handling, attestation, authorization, encryption or cache-storage behavior changes. T-041 (prefix-cache and SSD tier) and the other threat definitions are unaffected, because no change touches the cache salt, TTL, HMAC lookup, KEK handling or disk budget. The unchanged surrounding hardware-support.md text describes memory admission, the load gate and the Nemotron Super claim. It stays consistent with TB-007 and does not weaken any mitigation. Remaining uncertainty: I did not check that the cited path matches the actual repository layout. That is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security regression. No threat-model updates are needed.
